meta.title: Responses — view by vendor and by product
gaps: The prepared state has one bid rather than the requested RFQ with two bids, so the plan cannot verify one block per vendor for vendors A and B or compare both vendors' prices side by side.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The prepared state has one bid rather than the requested RFQ with two bids, so the plan cannot verify one block per vendor for vendors A and B or compare both vendors' prices side by side.

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ Responses screen directly as required for prepared-state cases.
Confirm the Responses screen is initially in the vendor-oriented view and offers the product-view toggle.
Switch the Responses display to the product-oriented view.
Confirm the control now offers switching back to the vendor-oriented view.
Switch the Responses display back to the vendor-oriented view.
Confirm the view toggle returned to the product-view option.
